recentItems.title: Backstroke Thriller Ends With Italian Gold 🇮🇹🏊‍♂️ | 100m Backstroke Final at Paris 2024
recentItems.description:
📺 Re-live #Paris2024! ➡️ https://oly.ch/3REmN8s

Italy’s Thomas Ceccon now has an Olympic gold medal to add to his world record and world championship in the men’s 100m backstroke. Ceccon was followed by Xu Jiayu from the People's Republic of China for the silver medal, with Team USA’s Ryan Murphy picking up the bronze at Paris 2024.

recentItems.title: ALL Olympic Throws: The Javelin Dominance of Neeraj Chopra 🇮🇳🥇
recentItems.description:
Indian javelin throw ace Neeraj Chopra has competed in 82 competitions since 2012 and won 43. He has finished in the top three on 66 occasions. From the moment he became Olympic champion at Tokyo 2020, Neeraj Chopra finished in the top two at every meet until the streak ended, incidentally, in Tokyo at the 2025 World Athletics Championships. The run lasted for 26 events. His podium streak, meanwhile, came to a halt after 33 consecutive tournaments.

recentItems.title: Ceremony for the Arrival of the Olympic Flame | Dakar 2026
recentItems.description:
The arrival of the Youth Olympic flame in September will mark one of the defining moments on the road to Dakar 2026. 

Following the lighting ceremony in Athens on 10 September, the flame will arrive in Dakar on 12 September before beginning a 30-stop journey across all regions of Senegal.  Supported by further local celebrations across the African continent, the tour is designed to bring the Games experience into communities and build anticipation ahead of the Opening Ceremony.

The Dakar 2026 YOG will take place from 31 October to 13 November 2026, bringing together around 2,700 young athletes aged up to 17 across three host zones: Dakar, Diamniadio and Saly.
